Iran war live: 12 killed in Riyadh, Saudi-led coalition vows to respond | US-Israel war on Iran News | Al Jazeera Skip linksSkip to Content Live Sign up Navigation menuNews Show more news sectionsAfrica
As strikes on airports in Saudi Arabia turn deadly, Washington debates striking Houthis and restarting strikes on Iran.
Yemen’s Houthis release video of drone attacks on gov’t forces
Saudi Arabia’s civil aviation authority says 12 people were killed and 309 injured in the latest Houthi attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid airport, as the Saudi-led coalition vows to respond.
Following the attack, US President Donald Trump said he would “take a look” at joining Saudi Arabia in striking the Houthis and that he plans to call Saudi Prime Minister Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
